title: S8_confounds_and_physio_regressors QC Status
description: QC status schema for S8 step (aggregated per dataset key)

n_columns_csf.description: Flat-TSV CSF aCompCor column total = components × N_slices (storage size). The per-slice model size is n_csf_components_per_slice.

n_csf_components_per_slice.description: CSF aCompCor PCs a single slice's GLM fits (e.g. 5). This is the meaningful model dimensionality, not the stacked n_columns_csf.

n_csf_slices.description: Number of slices that received CSF aCompCor components.

condition_number.description: Worst per-slice design conditioning (global regressors + that slice's per-slice CSF/RETROICOR columns). Slicewise GLM gate, not the flat-matrix number — see _condition_number_slicewise.

condition_number_global.description: Conditioning of the global-only regressors (motion, cosine, spinalcompcor, slice-mean RETROICOR, outliers); per-slice families excluded.

condition_number_worst_slice.description: Slice index whose design has the worst (headline) condition number.

cardiac_bpm_estimate.description: Cardiac rate (bpm) from FSL popp peak detection. Null when physio absent.

respiratory_cpm_estimate.description: Respiratory cycle rate (cpm) from popp phase wraps. Null when physio absent.

spinalcompcor_n_components.description: Number of SpinalCompCor PCs included. Equals fixed_n_components in global_3d mode (default); median(pcs_per_slice) in slicewise mode. Null when SpinalCompCor disabled.

carpet_plot.description: Cord-restricted voxel × time BOLD intensity image with FD/DVARS traces (Power 2017 / fMRIPrep).

fd_dvars_outliers.description: FD + DVARS + refRMS time series, outlier frames marked

confound_columns.description: Per-family regressor count bar chart with status pill

pnm_peaks.description: FSL popp cardiac peaks + respiratory phase; placeholder when physio absent

correlation_heatmap.description: Pearson r matrix across confound columns (multicollinearity proxy)
